ko.title: 샐러드 보울 속 기생충: 미국 최대 규모의 사이클로스포라 집단 감염이 드러낸 신선 농산물 이력 추적의 사각지대

segments.src: *Editor's note: Outbreak counts are provisional and change as state labs report.
segments.tr: *편집자 주: 집단 감염 건수는 잠정치이며 주립 연구소의 보고에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For the current case tally, recall list, and clinical guidance, consult the CDC and FDA directly.
segments.tr: 현재 사례 집계, 회수 목록 및 임상 지침은 CDC 및 FDA에서 직접 확인하십시오.

segments.src: Nothing here is medical advice.*
segments.tr: 본 문서의 어떠한 내용도 의학적 조언이 아닙니다.*

segments.src: Most foodborne outbreaks in the United States end the same way: a recall notice, a few days of headlines, and a quiet return to normal.
segments.tr: 미국의 대부분의 식중독 집단 감염은 동일한 방식으로 끝납니다. 회수 공지, 며칠간의 헤드라인, 그리고 평온한 일상으로의 복귀입니다.

segments.src: The cyclosporiasis outbreak that began building in May has not followed that script.
segments.tr: 지난 5월부터 확산하기 시작한 사이클로스포라증(cyclosporiasis) 집단 감염은 그 수순을 따르지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Federal and state health agencies now count roughly 18,000 confirmed or probable cases across 45 states — the largest cyclosporiasis outbreak on record in the U.S.
segments.tr: 연방 및 주 보건 당국은 현재 45개 주에서 약 18,000건의 확진 또는 의심 사례를 집계하고 있으며, 이는 미국 기록상 가장 큰 규모의 사이클로스포라증 집단 감염입니다.

segments.src: Investigators have pointed to a run of imported iceberg lettuce, since recalled, as a leading vehicle.
segments.tr: 조사관들은 수입되어 이후 회수된 양상추 물량을 주요 원인 유력 매개체로 지목했습니다.

segments.src: Hundreds of people have been hospitalized.
segments.tr: 수백 명의 사람들이 입원했습니다.

segments.src: The number is still moving, because the way this particular parasite gets counted almost guarantees the first number is never the final one.
segments.tr: 이 특정 기생충이 집계되는 방식 때문에 첫 번째 수치가 결코 최종 수치가 될 수 없어서, 수치는 여전히 변동 중입니다.

segments.src: The recall is the easy part of this story.
segments.tr: 제품 회수는 이 사태에서 쉬운 부분에 불과합니다.

segments.src: The hard part is what the investigation revealed on its way there: for a country that eats an enormous volume of fresh, raw, ready-to-eat produce, the United States has remarkably thin visibility into where any given leaf actually came from.
segments.tr: 어려운 부분은 조사가 진행되는 과정에서 드러난 사실입니다. 엄청난 양의 신선한 생 샐러드용 농산물을 소비하는 국가임에도 불구하고, 미국은 임의의 잎채소 한 장이 실제로 어디서 왔는지 파악하는 이력 추적 능력이 현저히 떨어집니다.

segments.src: ## A parasite built to slip through
segments.tr: ## 감시망을 빠져나가도록 설계된 기생충

segments.src: *Cyclospora cayetanensis* is a single-celled parasite, not a bacterium, and that distinction drives nearly everything about why it is difficult to catch.
segments.tr: *Cyclospora cayetanensis*는 세균이 아닌 단세포 기생충이며, 이러한 차이점이 왜 포획하기 어려운지 거의 모든 것을 설명해 줍니다.

segments.src: It spreads through the fecal-oral route — typically when produce or water is contaminated somewhere upstream of the consumer.
segments.tr: 이 기생충은 분변-구강 경로로 전파되며, 일반적으로 소비자의 상류 지점에서 농산물이나 용수가 오염될 때 발생합니다.

segments.src: Unlike norovirus, it does not pass directly from person to person; the parasite's oocysts need days to weeks in the environment to become infectious.
segments.tr: 노로바이러스와 달리 사람 간 직접 전파되지는 않습니다. 기생충의 접란(oocysts)이 감염력을 가지려면 환경에서 며칠에서 수주일의 시간이 필요합니다.

segments.src: That means a sick food handler at your local deli is not a plausible source.
segments.tr: 즉, 동네 델리 매장의 아픈 식품 취급자가 원인일 가능성은 낮습니다.

segments.src: The contamination almost always happened earlier, in a field, a wash line, or an irrigation source.
segments.tr: 오염은 거의 항상 그 이전, 즉 재배지, 세척 라인 또는 관개 용수원에서 발생했습니다.

segments.src: Its incubation period is the second problem.
segments.tr: 잠복기는 두 번째 문제입니다.

segments.src: Symptoms usually appear about a week after exposure, sometimes longer.
segments.tr: 증상은 노출 후 보통 일주일 뒤에 나타나며 때로는 더 오래 걸리기도 합니다.

segments.src: By the time someone feels ill enough to see a doctor, the meal that made them sick is a fuzzy memory, the receipt is gone, and the produce itself has been eaten or thrown out.
segments.tr: 의사를 찾아갈 만큼 병세를 느낄 때쯤이면, 병을 일으킨 식사는 희미한 기억이 되고 영수증은 사라졌으며 농산물 자체는 이미 섭취했거나 버려진 후입니다.

segments.src: Ask a patient what they ate seven to ten days ago and you get a shrug — which is exactly what epidemiologists are working with.
segments.tr: 환자에게 7일에서 10일 전에 무엇을 먹었는지 물어보면 어깨를 으쓱할 뿐이며, 이것이 바로 역학 조사관들이 직면한 현실입니다.

segments.src: Then there is detection.
segments.tr: 그다음은 검출 문제입니다.

segments.src: Standard stool testing does not reliably find *Cyclospora* unless a lab is specifically looking for it.
segments.tr: 표준 대변 검사는 검실에서 특별히 *Cyclospora*를 찾지 않는 한 이를 안정적으로 찾아내지 못합니다.

segments.src: For years, that required specialized staining techniques that many labs simply did not run by default.
segments.tr: 수년 동안 이를 위해서는 많은 연구소가 기본적으로 수행하지 않는 특수 염색 기법이 필요했습니다.

segments.src: Wider adoption of multiplex molecular panels has improved the picture considerably, but it has also introduced a distortion: some of the apparent growth in case counts reflects better testing rather than more illness.
segments.tr: 다중 분자 검사법(multiplex molecular panels)의 광범위한 도입으로 상황이 많이 개선되었지만, 변형도 함께 유발되었습니다. 케이스 수의 표면적 증가 중 일부는 질병의 증가가 아닌 검사 능력의 향상을 반영합니다.

segments.src: Untangling the two is genuinely hard, and it is one reason public health officials tend to hedge when asked whether an outbreak is "getting worse."
segments.tr: 이 두 가지를 분리해 내는 것은 매우 어려우며, 이것이 보건 당국자가 집단 감염이 "악화되고 있는지" 질문을 받을 때 확답을 피하는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Finally, the parasite is durable in ways that frustrate the standard playbook.
segments.tr: 마지막으로, 이 기생충은 표준 대응 방식을 무력화할 정도로 내성이 강합니다.

segments.src: It is not meaningfully reduced by the chlorinated wash water used in commercial produce processing, and rinsing at home does not reliably remove it.
segments.tr: 상업용 농산물 가공에 사용되는 염소 소독 세척수로도 유의미하게 줄어들지 않으며, 집에서 헹구는 것으로도 안정적으로 제거되지 않습니다.

segments.src: There is no cooking step in a salad.
segments.tr: 샐러드에는 가열 조리 단계가 없습니다.

segments.src: Every intervention that works for other pathogens — heat, sanitizer, time — is either absent or ineffective here.
segments.tr: 열, 소독제, 시간 등 다른 병원체에 효과적인 모든 중재 조치가 여기서는 부재하거나 효과가 없습니다.

segments.src: ## Where the trail goes cold
segments.tr: ## 추적 단서가 끊어지는 지점

segments.src: When investigators trace a suspect head of lettuce backward, they are following a chain of records that was never designed for the question they are asking.
segments.tr: 조사관들이 의심스러운 양상추 한 포기를 역추적할 때, 그들은 자신들이 묻고 있는 질문을 해결하기 위해 설계된 적이 없는 기록의 사슬을 따라가고 있는 것입니다.

segments.src: A single bag or carton of leafy greens can represent produce from multiple fields, sometimes multiple farms, harvested on different days and commingled during cooling, washing, and packing.
segments.tr: 잎채소 한 봉지나 상자는 여러 농장, 때로는 여러 재배지에서 각기 다른 날에 수확되어 냉각, 세척 및 포장 과정에서 혼합된 농산물을 포함할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That commingling is efficient.
segments.tr: 이러한 혼합 작업은 효율적입니다.

segments.src: It is also a traceability solvent: it dissolves the link between one contaminated field and one sick person into a probability cloud spanning dozens of possible sources.
segments.tr: 그러나 이는 이력 추적의 용매이기도 합니다. 하나의 오염된 재배지와 한 명의 환자 사이의 연결 고리를 수십 개의 가능한 진원지를 포함하는 확률의 구름 속으로 녹여버립니다.

segments.src: The records themselves compound the problem.
segments.tr: 기록 자체도 문제를 가중시킵니다.

segments.src: Significant portions of the produce supply chain still run on paper, PDFs, and per-company formats that do not talk to each other.
segments.tr: 농산물 공급망의 상당 부분은 여전히 종이, PDF, 그리고 서로 호환되지 않는 회사별 양식으로 운영됩니다.

segments.src: Each handoff — grower to cooler, cooler to processor, processor to distributor, distributor to retailer — is documented, but in a way that requires human beings to manually reconcile documents from a dozen firms.
segments.tr: 재배자에서 냉장 시설, 냉장 시설에서 가공업체, 가공업체에서 유통업체, 유통업체에서 소매업체로의 각 인도 과정이 문서화되지만, 이는 사람이 수십 개 회사의 문서를 수동으로 대조해야 하는 방식입니다.

segments.src: Traceback that should take hours takes weeks.
segments.tr: 몇 시간 내에 완료되어야 할 역추적이 수주일이 걸립니다.

segments.src: And weeks, in a perishable product with a two-week shelf life, means the evidence has already been eaten.
segments.tr: 그리고 유통기한이 2주에 불과한 신선 식품에서 수주일이라는 시간은 증거가 이미 소비되었음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Imports add another layer.
segments.tr: 수입품은 또 다른 복잡성을 더합니다.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국은

segments.src: imports a large and growing share of its fresh produce, and physical inspection of incoming food shipments covers only a small fraction of entries — the vast majority clear on paperwork and risk-based screening rather than examination.
segments.tr: 신선 농산물의 상당 부분을 수입하고 있으며 점차 그 비중이 커지고 있습니다. 반면 반입되는 식품 화물에 대한 현장 물리적 검사는 전체의 극히 일부에 불과하며, 대다수는 검사가 아닌 서류 및 위험 기반 심사로 통과됩니다.

segments.src: That is not necessarily a scandal; inspecting everything is neither feasible nor how modern food safety is designed to work.
segments.tr: 이것이 반드시 스캔들인 것은 아닙니다. 모든 것을 검사하는 것은 실현 가능하지 않으며 현대 식품 안전이 작동하도록 설계된 방식도 아닙니다.

segments.src: The system is supposed to rely on preventive controls at the source, verified through supplier programs and audits.
segments.tr: 이 시스템은 공급업체 프로그램과 감사 조사를 통해 검증된 원천에서의 예방적 관리 조치에 의존하도록 되어 있습니다.

segments.src: But that model depends on those upstream controls actually functioning, and on being able to identify quickly which supplier failed when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: 그러나 이 모델은 상류의 관리 조치가 실제로 작동하고, 문제가 발생했을 때 어떤 공급업체가 실패했는지 신속하게 식별할 수 있는지에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: This outbreak tested both assumptions at once.
segments.tr: 이번 집단 감염은 두 가지 전제 조건을 동시에 시험했습니다.

segments.src: ## The rule that was supposed to fix this
segments.tr: ## 이 문제를 해결하기로 되어 있었던 규정

segments.src: Regulators have not been unaware of the gap.
segments.tr: 규제 당국이 이 격차를 인지하지 못했던 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: The FDA's Food Traceability Rule, issued under the Food Safety Modernization Act, was written precisely for this scenario.
segments.tr: 식품안전현대화법(FSMA)에 따라 발효된 FDA의 식품 이력 추적 규정(Food Traceability Rule)은 정확히 이러한 시나리오를 위해 작성되었습니다.

segments.src: It requires firms handling designated high-risk foods — leafy greens prominently among them — to keep standardized, lot-level records at each critical tracking event and to produce them in a common electronic format on request.
segments.tr: 이 규정은 주요 지정 위험 식품(잎채소가 대표적)을 취급하는 업체가 모든 핵심 추적 이벤트에서 표준화된 제조번호(Lot) 수준의 기록을 유지하고 요청 시 공통 전자 형식으로 제출하도록 요구합니다.

segments.src: In principle, that turns a multi-week paper chase into a database query.
segments.tr: 원칙적으로 이는 수주일간의 종이 서류 추적을 데이터베이스 조회로 바꾸어 놓습니다.

segments.src: In practice, the compliance deadline has been pushed back, most recently to 2028, following industry arguments about cost and readiness — concerns that are not trivial, particularly for smaller growers and for import chains where the first link sits in another country's regulatory system.
segments.tr: 실제로는 비용과 준비 상태에 대한 업계의 반발로 인해 준수 시한이 가장 최근에는 2028년으로 연기되었습니다. 이러한 우려는 특히 소규모 재배자와 첫 번째 고리가 다른 국가의 규제 시스템에 속해 있는 수입망의 경우 가볍지 않은 문제입니다.

segments.src: The delay was defensible on its own terms.
segments.tr: 유예 자체는 나름의 명분이 있었습니다.

segments.src: The consequence is also plain: the outbreak now on the books happened inside the window before the fix took effect.
segments.tr: 그러나 그 결과 또한 명확합니다. 현재 발생한 집단 감염은 개정안이 효력을 발휘하기 전의 유예 기간 내에 일어났습니다.

segments.src: That is the honest tension in this story.
segments.tr: 이것이 이 사태의 솔직한 갈등 구조입니다.

segments.src: There is no villain in it.
segments.tr: 여기에는 악당이 없습니다.

segments.src: There is a rule that would likely have shortened this traceback, an industry that raised real implementation objections, a regulator that granted more time, and a parasite that did not wait.
segments.tr: 이 역추적 기간을 단축했을 규정이 있었고, 실질적인 이행상의 어려움을 제기한 업계가 있었으며, 더 많은 시간을 허용한 규제 당국이 있었고, 기다려주지 않은 기생충이 있었을 뿐입니다.

segments.src: ## What it means at the grocery store
segments.tr: ## 식료품점 매장에서 이것이 의미하는 바

segments.src: The practical guidance here is narrower than the scale of the outbreak might suggest, and it is worth being precise rather than alarming.
segments.tr: 여기서 실질적인 지침은 집단 감염의 규모가 시사하는 것보다 좁으며, 불안해하기보다는 정확한 사실을 아는 것이 중요합니다.

segments.src: - **Recalls are specific.** They apply to identified lots, brands, and date ranges — not to lettuce as a category. Checking the FDA recall list against what is actually in your refrigerator is more useful than avoiding salad.
segments.tr: - **회수는 특정 사안입니다.** 전체 채소 카테고리가 아니라 식별된 특정 제조번호(Lot), 브랜드 및 날짜 범위에 적용됩니다. 샐러드를 피하는 것보다 냉장고에 실제로 있는 제품을 FDA 회수 목록과 비교하는 것이 더 유용합니다.

segments.src: - **Washing is not a fix for this pathogen.** Rinsing produce remains good practice for other reasons, but it should not be treated as a safeguard against *Cyclospora* specifically.
segments.tr: - **세척은 이 병원체에 대한 해결책이 아닙니다.** 농산물을 헹구는 것은 다른 이유로 여전히 좋은 습관이지만, *Cyclospora*에 대한 전용 예방책으로 여겨져서는 안 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Symptoms warrant a conversation with a clinician, not self-diagnosis.** Cyclosporiasis typically presents as prolonged, watery diarrhea, often relapsing, sometimes lasting weeks without treatment. It is treatable, but it requires a targeted test that a lab will generally not run unless a physician asks for it — which is why mentioning recent produce consumption or a recall matters.
segments.tr: - **증상이 나타나면 자가 진단이 아닌 전문의와의 상담이 필요합니다.** 사이클로스포라증은 일반적으로 지속적이고 물 같은 설사로 나타나며, 자주 재발하고 치료받지 않으면 몇 주 동안 지속되기도 합니다. 치료가 가능하지만 연구소에서 의사가 요청하지 않는 한 일반적으로 시행하지 않는 표적 검사가 필요합니다. 최근 농산물 섭취 여부나 회수 사실을 언급하는 것이 중요한 이유가 바로 여기에 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Reporting is not a formality.** Case counts and traceback both depend on people showing up and getting tested. In an outbreak driven by a pathogen this easy to miss, the confirmed number is a floor, not a measurement.
segments.tr: - **신고는 형식적인 절차가 아닙니다.** 사례 수 집계와 역추적 모두 사람들이 병원에 방문하여 검사를 받는 것에 의존합니다. 이처럼 놓치기 쉬운 병원체로 인한 집단 감염에서 확진된 수치는 수량 측정값이 아니라 최저선(하한선)입니다.

segments.src: ## The system question
segments.tr: ## 시스템적 질문

segments.src: Eighteen thousand cases is a large number, but it is not really the finding.
segments.tr: 18,000건은 큰 수치이지만 이것이 핵심 발견은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Outbreaks of this size have happened before and will again.
segments.tr: 이 정도 규모의 집단 감염은 전에도 일어났고 앞으로도 다시 일어날 것입니다.

segments.src: The finding is that a country can move millions of pounds of raw, ready-to-eat produce through a continental supply chain every week and still need weeks to answer a basic question: *which field did this come from?* Every other part of the modern food system — pricing, logistics, inventory, demand forecasting — runs on granular real-time data.
segments.tr: 핵심 발견은 한 국가가 매주 대륙 규모의 공급망을 통해 수백만 파운드의 갓 수확한 생 샐러드용 농산물을 이동시키면서도, *이 제품이 어느 재배지에서 왔는가?*라는 기본적인 질문에 답하기 위해 여전히 수주일이 필요하다는 사실입니다. 현대 식품 시스템의 다른 모든 분야(가격 책정, 물류, 재고, 수요 예측)는 세밀한 실시간 데이터를 기반으로 운영됩니다.

segments.src: Traceability, the one function that matters most when something goes wrong, has been the last to get it.
segments.tr: 문제가 발생했을 때 가장 중요한 단 하나의 기능인 이력 추적이 이를 적용받는 가장 마지막 분야였습니다.

segments.src: The recalled lettuce will clear the shelves.
segments.tr: 회수된 양상추는 매대에서 사라질 것입니다.

segments.src: The blind spot it exposed will still be there in the fall, and in the next harvest, and the one after that — until lot-level traceability stops being a deadline that can be extended and starts being how the pipeline simply works.
segments.tr: 그러나 이것이 드러낸 사각지대는 올가을에도, 다음 수확기에도, 그다음 수확기에도 그대로 남아 있을 것입니다. 제조번호 수준의 이력 추적이 연장할 수 있는 마감 시한이기를 멈추고 파이프라인이 단순히 작동하는 기본 방식이 될 때까지는 말입니다.

zh.title: 沙拉碗里的寄生虫：美国最大规模环孢子虫爆发揭示了鲜切农产品的追溯盲区

segments.src: *Editor's note: Outbreak counts are provisional and change as state labs report.
segments.tr: *编者按：爆发统计数据为阶段性数据，随着各州实验室的报告而有所变化。

segments.src: For the current case tally, recall list, and clinical guidance, consult the CDC and FDA directly.
segments.tr: 有关最新的病例统计、召回清单和临床指南，请直接咨询 CDC 和 FDA。

segments.src: Nothing here is medical advice.*
segments.tr: 本文不构成任何医疗建议。*

segments.src: Most foodborne outbreaks in the United States end the same way: a recall notice, a few days of headlines, and a quiet return to normal.
segments.tr: 在美国，大多数食源性疾病的爆发都以同样的方式结束：一份召回通知，几天的头条新闻，然后平静地恢复正常。

segments.src: The cyclosporiasis outbreak that began building in May has not followed that script.
segments.tr: 自 5 月开始蔓延的环孢子虫病爆发却没有遵循这一剧本。

segments.src: Federal and state health agencies now count roughly 18,000 confirmed or probable cases across 45 states — the largest cyclosporiasis outbreak on record in the U.S.
segments.tr: 联邦和州卫生机构目前在 45 个州统计出约 18,000 例确诊或疑似病例——这是美国有记录以来规模最大的一起环孢子虫病爆发。

segments.src: Investigators have pointed to a run of imported iceberg lettuce, since recalled, as a leading vehicle.
segments.tr: 调查人员指出，一批进口的球生菜（现已被召回）是主要的传播媒介。

segments.src: Hundreds of people have been hospitalized.
segments.tr: 数以百计的人住院治疗。

segments.src: The number is still moving, because the way this particular parasite gets counted almost guarantees the first number is never the final one.
segments.tr: 由于这种特定寄生虫的统计方式几乎确保了最初的数据绝非最终数据，因此该数字仍在持续变化。

segments.src: The recall is the easy part of this story.
segments.tr: 召回只是这个故事中简单的一部分。

segments.src: The hard part is what the investigation revealed on its way there: for a country that eats an enormous volume of fresh, raw, ready-to-eat produce, the United States has remarkably thin visibility into where any given leaf actually came from.
segments.tr: 艰难的部分在于调查过程中暴露出的问题：对于一个消耗大量新鲜、生食、即食农产品的国家来说，美国对于任何给定的菜叶究竟来自哪里，其可见性异常薄弱。

segments.src: ## A parasite built to slip through
segments.tr: ## 一种专为逃避监管而生的寄生虫

segments.src: *Cyclospora cayetanensis* is a single-celled parasite, not a bacterium, and that distinction drives nearly everything about why it is difficult to catch.
segments.tr: *Cyclospora cayetanensis* 是一种单细胞寄生虫，而不是细菌，这种本质区别解释了为什么它极难被捕捉。

segments.src: It spreads through the fecal-oral route — typically when produce or water is contaminated somewhere upstream of the consumer.
segments.tr: 它通过粪口途径传播——通常是在消费者上游的某个环节，农产品或水受到了污染。

segments.src: Unlike norovirus, it does not pass directly from person to person; the parasite's oocysts need days to weeks in the environment to become infectious.
segments.tr: 与诺如病毒不同，它不会在人与人之间直接传播；该寄生虫的卵囊需要在环境中停留几天到几周才能具备传染性。

segments.src: That means a sick food handler at your local deli is not a plausible source.
segments.tr: 这意味着你当地熟食店里生病的食品处理人员并不是合理的污染源。

segments.src: The contamination almost always happened earlier, in a field, a wash line, or an irrigation source.
segments.tr: 污染几乎总是发生在更早的环节，比如农田、清洗线或灌溉水源。

segments.src: Its incubation period is the second problem.
segments.tr: 它的潜伏期是第二个问题。

segments.src: Symptoms usually appear about a week after exposure, sometimes longer.
segments.tr: 症状通常在接触后一周左右出现，有时更长。

segments.src: By the time someone feels ill enough to see a doctor, the meal that made them sick is a fuzzy memory, the receipt is gone, and the produce itself has been eaten or thrown out.
segments.tr: 当有人感到足够不适去看医生时，让他们生病的那顿饭已经变成了模糊的记忆，收据找不到了，而农产品本身已经被吃掉或扔掉了。

segments.src: Ask a patient what they ate seven to ten days ago and you get a shrug — which is exactly what epidemiologists are working with.
segments.tr: 询问患者 7 到 10 天前吃了什么，你只会得到一个摇头的回应——而这恰恰是流行病学家所面临的实际工作困境。

segments.src: Then there is detection.
segments.tr: 其次是检测问题。

segments.src: Standard stool testing does not reliably find *Cyclospora* unless a lab is specifically looking for it.
segments.tr: 除非实验室专门寻找 *Cyclospora*，否则标准粪便检测无法可靠地发现它。

segments.src: For years, that required specialized staining techniques that many labs simply did not run by default.
segments.tr: 多年来，这需要特殊的染色技术，而许多实验室默认并不开展这项检测。

segments.src: Wider adoption of multiplex molecular panels has improved the picture considerably, but it has also introduced a distortion: some of the apparent growth in case counts reflects better testing rather than more illness.
segments.tr: 多重分子检测技术（multiplex molecular panels）的广泛应用显著改善了这一状况，但也引入了一种失真：病例数表面上的增长，部分反映的是检测能力的提升，而不是实际发病率的增加。

segments.src: Untangling the two is genuinely hard, and it is one reason public health officials tend to hedge when asked whether an outbreak is "getting worse."
segments.tr: 将这两者区分开来确实非常困难，这也是公共卫生官员在被问及疫情是否在“恶化”时往往含糊其辞的原因之一。

segments.src: Finally, the parasite is durable in ways that frustrate the standard playbook.
segments.tr: 最后，这种寄生虫具有极强的耐受性，挫败了标准的应对方案。

segments.src: It is not meaningfully reduced by the chlorinated wash water used in commercial produce processing, and rinsing at home does not reliably remove it.
segments.tr: 商业农产品加工中使用的含氯清洗水无法显著减少其数量，在家冲洗也无法可靠地将其清除。

segments.src: There is no cooking step in a salad.
segments.tr: 沙拉没有加热烹饪环节。

segments.src: Every intervention that works for other pathogens — heat, sanitizer, time — is either absent or ineffective here.
segments.tr: 对其他病原体有效的每一种干预措施——热力、消毒剂、时间——在这里要么缺失，要么无效。

segments.src: ## Where the trail goes cold
segments.tr: ## 线索中断的地方

segments.src: When investigators trace a suspect head of lettuce backward, they are following a chain of records that was never designed for the question they are asking.
segments.tr: 当调查人员反向追溯一棵可疑的生菜时，他们追踪的是一套从未针对他们所提出的问题而设计的记录体系。

segments.src: A single bag or carton of leafy greens can represent produce from multiple fields, sometimes multiple farms, harvested on different days and commingled during cooling, washing, and packing.
segments.tr: 一袋或一箱叶菜可能代表来自多个农田、甚至多个农场的农产品，它们在不同的日子采摘，并在冷却、清洗和包装过程中混合在一起。

segments.src: That commingling is efficient.
segments.tr: 这种混合在商业上是高效的。

segments.src: It is also a traceability solvent: it dissolves the link between one contaminated field and one sick person into a probability cloud spanning dozens of possible sources.
segments.tr: 但它也是追溯力的溶剂：它将一块受污染的农田与一名患者之间的联系，溶解成了横跨几十个可能来源的概率云。

segments.src: The records themselves compound the problem.
segments.tr: 记录本身加剧了这个问题。

segments.src: Significant portions of the produce supply chain still run on paper, PDFs, and per-company formats that do not talk to each other.
segments.tr: 农产品供应链的大部分环节仍在使用纸质文档、PDF 以及互不兼容的公司独立格式运行。

segments.src: Each handoff — grower to cooler, cooler to processor, processor to distributor, distributor to retailer — is documented, but in a way that requires human beings to manually reconcile documents from a dozen firms.
segments.tr: 每一次交接——种植者到冷库，冷库到加工商，加工商到分销商，分销商到零售商——都有记录，但其记录方式需要人工去比对来自十几家公司的文件。

segments.src: Traceback that should take hours takes weeks.
segments.tr: 本应花费几小时的追溯，却需要花费数周时间。

segments.src: And weeks, in a perishable product with a two-week shelf life, means the evidence has already been eaten.
segments.tr: 而在保质期仅为两周的易腐产品中，数周的时间意味着证据早已被吃掉了。

segments.src: Imports add another layer.
segments.tr: 进口又增加了另一层复杂性。

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: imports a large and growing share of its fresh produce, and physical inspection of incoming food shipments covers only a small fraction of entries — the vast majority clear on paperwork and risk-based screening rather than examination.
segments.tr: 进口的新鲜农产品比例巨大且不断增长，而对入境食品货物的实物检查仅覆盖了极小的一部分——绝大多数凭文件和基于风险的筛选即可通关，而非接受物理检查。

segments.src: That is not necessarily a scandal; inspecting everything is neither feasible nor how modern food safety is designed to work.
segments.tr: 这未必是什么丑闻；对所有货物进行检查既不可行，也不是现代食品安全机制的设计初衷。

segments.src: The system is supposed to rely on preventive controls at the source, verified through supplier programs and audits.
segments.tr: 该系统本应依赖于源头处的预防性控制，并通过供应商计划和审计来进行验证。

segments.src: But that model depends on those upstream controls actually functioning, and on being able to identify quickly which supplier failed when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: 但该模式取决于这些上游控制措施是否真正发挥作用，以及当出现问题时能否快速识别出哪家供应商出现了失误。

segments.src: This outbreak tested both assumptions at once.
segments.tr: 这次爆发同时考验了这两个假设。

segments.src: ## The rule that was supposed to fix this
segments.tr: ## 原本旨在解决此问题的法规

segments.src: Regulators have not been unaware of the gap.
segments.tr: 监管机构并非没有意识到这一差距。

segments.src: The FDA's Food Traceability Rule, issued under the Food Safety Modernization Act, was written precisely for this scenario.
segments.tr: FDA 根据《食品安全现代化法案》颁布的《食品可追溯性规则》（Food Traceability Rule）正是为了应对这种情景而制定的。

segments.src: It requires firms handling designated high-risk foods — leafy greens prominently among them — to keep standardized, lot-level records at each critical tracking event and to produce them in a common electronic format on request.
segments.tr: 它要求处理指定高风险食品（叶菜名列前茅）的企业在每个关键追踪环节保持标准化、批次级（lot-level）的记录，并在收到要求时以统一的电子格式提供。

segments.src: In principle, that turns a multi-week paper chase into a database query.
segments.tr: 原则上，这能将长达数周的纸质追踪转变为一次数据库查询。

segments.src: In practice, the compliance deadline has been pushed back, most recently to 2028, following industry arguments about cost and readiness — concerns that are not trivial, particularly for smaller growers and for import chains where the first link sits in another country's regulatory system.
segments.tr: 但在实践中，在行业关于成本和准备情况的争论下，合规截止日期被推迟了，最近一次推迟到了 2028 年——这些担忧并非小事，特别是对于规模较小的种植者以及第一环节处于另一个国家监管体系下的进口链而言。

segments.src: The delay was defensible on its own terms.
segments.tr: 从其自身理由来看，这种延迟是有据可依的。

segments.src: The consequence is also plain: the outbreak now on the books happened inside the window before the fix took effect.
segments.tr: 但后果也是显而易见的：目前记录在案的这次爆发，恰恰发生在修复措施生效前的窗口期内。

segments.src: That is the honest tension in this story.
segments.tr: 这就是这个故事中最真实的矛盾所在。

segments.src: There is no villain in it.
segments.tr: 其中没有反派。

segments.src: There is a rule that would likely have shortened this traceback, an industry that raised real implementation objections, a regulator that granted more time, and a parasite that did not wait.
segments.tr: 本有一项很可能缩短此次追溯时间的规则，一个提出了切实实施异议的行业，一个给予了更多时间的监管机构，以及一个不会停下脚步等待的寄生虫。

segments.src: ## What it means at the grocery store
segments.tr: ## 这对杂货店消费者意味着什么

segments.src: The practical guidance here is narrower than the scale of the outbreak might suggest, and it is worth being precise rather than alarming.
segments.tr: 这里的实用指导意见比疫情爆发的规模所暗示的要窄，准确客观比危言耸听更有价值。

segments.src: - **Recalls are specific.** They apply to identified lots, brands, and date ranges — not to lettuce as a category. Checking the FDA recall list against what is actually in your refrigerator is more useful than avoiding salad.
segments.tr: - **召回是具象且具体的。** 它们适用于特定认定的批次、品牌和日期范围，而不是针对生菜这整个品类。核对 FDA 召回清单与你冰箱里的实际物品，比完全不吃沙拉更有用。

segments.src: - **Washing is not a fix for this pathogen.** Rinsing produce remains good practice for other reasons, but it should not be treated as a safeguard against *Cyclospora* specifically.
segments.tr: - **清洗并不是针对这种病原体的解决办法。** 出于其他原因，冲洗农产品仍然是个好习惯，但不应将其视为针对 *Cyclospora* 的防护手段。

segments.src: - **Symptoms warrant a conversation with a clinician, not self-diagnosis.** Cyclosporiasis typically presents as prolonged, watery diarrhea, often relapsing, sometimes lasting weeks without treatment. It is treatable, but it requires a targeted test that a lab will generally not run unless a physician asks for it — which is why mentioning recent produce consumption or a recall matters.
segments.tr: - **出现症状需要与医生沟通，而不是自我诊断。** 环孢子虫病通常表现为持续性的水样腹泻，经常复发，如果不治疗有时会持续数周。它是可以治疗的，但需要进行针对性检测，除非医生提出要求，否则实验室通常不会运行该检测——这就是为什么提及最近的农产品食用史或召回信息非常重要的原因。

segments.src: - **Reporting is not a formality.** Case counts and traceback both depend on people showing up and getting tested. In an outbreak driven by a pathogen this easy to miss, the confirmed number is a floor, not a measurement.
segments.tr: - **上报并非例行公事。** 病例统计和追溯都依赖于人们前往就医并接受检测。在由这种极易漏诊的病原体引发的爆发中，确诊数字只是底线，而非精确测量值。

segments.src: ## The system question
segments.tr: ## 系统性思考

segments.src: Eighteen thousand cases is a large number, but it is not really the finding.
segments.tr: 18,000 例是一个很大的数字，但它并不是真正的核心发现。

segments.src: Outbreaks of this size have happened before and will again.
segments.tr: 这种规模的爆发以前发生过，将来还会发生。

segments.src: The finding is that a country can move millions of pounds of raw, ready-to-eat produce through a continental supply chain every week and still need weeks to answer a basic question: *which field did this come from?* Every other part of the modern food system — pricing, logistics, inventory, demand forecasting — runs on granular real-time data.
segments.tr: 核心发现在于，一个国家每周可以通过跨洲供应链运输数百万磅的新鲜、生食、即食农产品，却仍需要数周时间来回答一个基本问题：*这到底来自哪块农田？* 现代食品系统的所有其他部分——定价、物流、库存、需求预测——都依托于细粒度的实时数据运行。

segments.src: Traceability, the one function that matters most when something goes wrong, has been the last to get it.
segments.tr: 而可追溯性——在出现问题时最为关键的一项功能——却是最后一个获得这种数据支持的。

segments.src: The recalled lettuce will clear the shelves.
segments.tr: 被召回的生菜终将从货架上清空。

segments.src: The blind spot it exposed will still be there in the fall, and in the next harvest, and the one after that — until lot-level traceability stops being a deadline that can be extended and starts being how the pipeline simply works.
segments.tr: 但它所暴露出的盲区在今年秋天、在下一次收获季以及再下一次收获季依然会存在——直到批次级可追溯性不再是一个可以不断延期的截止日期，而成为整个供应链自然运转的基础方式。

hi.title: सलाद बाउल में परजीवी: अमेरिका में साइक्लोस्पोरा के अब तक के सबसे बड़े प्रकोप से ताज़ा उपज के ब्लाइंड स्पॉट के बारे में क्या पता चलता है

segments.src: *Editor's note: Outbreak counts are provisional and change as state labs report.
segments.tr: *संपादक की टिप्पणी: प्रकोप की संख्या अनंतिम है और राज्य की प्रयोगशालाओं की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार बदलती रहती है।

segments.src: For the current case tally, recall list, and clinical guidance, consult the CDC and FDA directly.
segments.tr: वर्तमान मामलों की संख्या, रिकॉल सूची और नैदानिक मार्गदर्शन के लिए, सीधे CDC और FDA से परामर्श करें।

segments.src: Nothing here is medical advice.*
segments.tr: यहाँ दी गई कोई भी जानकारी चिकित्सकीय सलाह नहीं है।*

segments.src: Most foodborne outbreaks in the United States end the same way: a recall notice, a few days of headlines, and a quiet return to normal.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में भोजन से होने वाली अधिकांश बीमारियों के प्रकोप एक ही तरह से समाप्त होते हैं: एक रिकॉल नोटिस, कुछ दिनों की सुर्खियां, और सामान्य स्थिति में एक शांत वापसी।

segments.src: The cyclosporiasis outbreak that began building in May has not followed that script.
segments.tr: मई में बढ़ना शुरू हुआ साइक्लोस्पोरियासिस (cyclosporiasis) का प्रकोप उस पटकथा पर नहीं चला है।

segments.src: Federal and state health agencies now count roughly 18,000 confirmed or probable cases across 45 states — the largest cyclosporiasis outbreak on record in the U.S.
segments.tr: संघीय और राज्य स्वास्थ्य एजेंसियां अब 45 राज्यों में लगभग 18,000 पुष्ट या संभावित मामलों की गिनती कर रही हैं — जो कि अमेरिका में दर्ज साइक्लोस्पोरियासिस का सबसे बड़ा प्रकोप है।

segments.src: Investigators have pointed to a run of imported iceberg lettuce, since recalled, as a leading vehicle.
segments.tr: जांचकर्ताओं ने आयातित आइसबर्ग लेट्यूस की एक खेप की ओर इशारा किया है, जिसे अब वापस ले लिया गया है, जो प्राथमिक माध्यम रहा है।

segments.src: Hundreds of people have been hospitalized.
segments.tr: सैंकड़ों लोगों को अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया है।

segments.src: The number is still moving, because the way this particular parasite gets counted almost guarantees the first number is never the final one.
segments.tr: यह संख्या अभी भी बदल रही है, क्योंकि जिस तरह से इस विशेष परजीवी की गिनती की जाती है, वह लगभग यह गारंटी देता है कि पहली संख्या कभी अंतिम संख्या नहीं होती है।

segments.src: The recall is the easy part of this story.
segments.tr: उत्पाद को वापस मंगाना (रिकॉल) इस कहानी का आसान हिस्सा है।

segments.src: The hard part is what the investigation revealed on its way there: for a country that eats an enormous volume of fresh, raw, ready-to-eat produce, the United States has remarkably thin visibility into where any given leaf actually came from.
segments.tr: कठिन हिस्सा वह है जो जांच ने वहां पहुंचने के रास्ते में उजागर किया: एक ऐसा देश जो भारी मात्रा में ताजा, कच्ची, खाने के लिए तैयार उपज खाता है, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के पास यह ट्रैक करने की बहुत कमजोर क्षमता है कि कोई भी पत्ती वास्तव में कहां से आई है।

segments.src: ## A parasite built to slip through
segments.tr: ## एक परजीवी जो पकड़ में न आने के लिए बना है

segments.src: *Cyclospora cayetanensis* is a single-celled parasite, not a bacterium, and that distinction drives nearly everything about why it is difficult to catch.
segments.tr: *Cyclospora cayetanensis* एक एकल-कोशिकीय (single-celled) परजीवी है, जीवाणु (bacterium) नहीं, और यही अंतर इस बात की मुख्य वजह है कि इसे पकड़ना इतना कठिन क्यों है।

segments.src: It spreads through the fecal-oral route — typically when produce or water is contaminated somewhere upstream of the consumer.
segments.tr: यह मल-मुख मार्ग (fecal-oral route) से फैलता है — आमतौर पर तब जब उपभोक्ता से ऊपर के स्तर पर उपज या पानी दूषित हो जाता है।

segments.src: Unlike norovirus, it does not pass directly from person to person; the parasite's oocysts need days to weeks in the environment to become infectious.
segments.tr: नोरोवायरस के विपरीत, यह व्यक्ति से व्यक्ति में सीधे नहीं फैलता है; परजीवी के ऊसाइट्स (oocysts) को संक्रामक बनने के लिए पर्यावरण में दिनों से लेकर हफ्तों तक के समय की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: That means a sick food handler at your local deli is not a plausible source.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब यह है कि आपकी स्थानीय दुकान पर बीमार खाद्य हैंडलर एक संभावित स्रोत नहीं है।

segments.src: The contamination almost always happened earlier, in a field, a wash line, or an irrigation source.
segments.tr: दूषित होना लगभग हमेशा पहले हुआ होता है, किसी खेत में, धोने की लाइन में, या सिंचाई के स्रोत में।

segments.src: Its incubation period is the second problem.
segments.tr: इसकी ऊष्मायन अवधि (incubation period) दूसरी समस्या है।

segments.src: Symptoms usually appear about a week after exposure, sometimes longer.
segments.tr: लक्षण आमतौर पर संपर्क में आने के लगभग एक सप्ताह बाद दिखाई देते हैं, कभी-कभी अधिक समय भी लगता है।

segments.src: By the time someone feels ill enough to see a doctor, the meal that made them sick is a fuzzy memory, the receipt is gone, and the produce itself has been eaten or thrown out.
segments.tr: जब तक कोई व्यक्ति डॉक्टर से मिलने के लिए पर्याप्त बीमार महसूस करता है, तब तक जिस भोजन ने उसे बीमार किया था, वह एक धुंधली याद बन जाता है, रसीद गायब हो जाती है, और उपज खुद खाई जा चुकी होती है या फेंक दी गई होती है।

segments.src: Ask a patient what they ate seven to ten days ago and you get a shrug — which is exactly what epidemiologists are working with.
segments.tr: किसी मरीज से पूछें कि उन्होंने सात से दस दिन पहले क्या खाया था और आपको केवल असमंजस भरा जवाब मिलेगा — महामारी विज्ञानियों (epidemiologists) को इसी चुनौती के साथ काम करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: Then there is detection.
segments.tr: फिर जांच (detection) की बात आती है।

segments.src: Standard stool testing does not reliably find *Cyclospora* unless a lab is specifically looking for it.
segments.tr: मानक मल परीक्षण विश्वसनीयता से *Cyclospora* का पता नहीं लगाता जब तक कि कोई प्रयोगशाला विशेष रूप से इसकी तलाश न कर रही हो।

segments.src: For years, that required specialized staining techniques that many labs simply did not run by default.
segments.tr: वर्षों से, इसके लिए विशेष धुंधलापन तकनीक (staining techniques) की आवश्यकता होती थी जो कई प्रयोगशालाएं डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से नहीं चलाती थीं।

segments.src: Wider adoption of multiplex molecular panels has improved the picture considerably, but it has also introduced a distortion: some of the apparent growth in case counts reflects better testing rather than more illness.
segments.tr: मल्टीप्लेक्स मॉलिक्यूलर पैनल (multiplex molecular panels) के व्यापक रूप से अपनाए जाने से स्थिति में काफी सुधार हुआ है, लेकिन इसने एक विकृति भी पैदा की है: मामलों की संख्या में स्पष्ट वृद्धि का कुछ हिस्सा अधिक बीमारी के बजाय बेहतर परीक्षण को दर्शाता है।

segments.src: Untangling the two is genuinely hard, and it is one reason public health officials tend to hedge when asked whether an outbreak is "getting worse."
segments.tr: इन दोनों को सुलझाना वास्तव में कठिन है, और यह एक कारण है कि सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य अधिकारी अक्सर टालमटोल करते हैं जब उनसे पूछा जाता है कि क्या प्रकोप "बढ़ रहा है।"

segments.src: Finally, the parasite is durable in ways that frustrate the standard playbook.
segments.tr: अंत में, परजीवी इस तरह से टिकाऊ है जो मानक नियमों को विफल कर देता है।

segments.src: It is not meaningfully reduced by the chlorinated wash water used in commercial produce processing, and rinsing at home does not reliably remove it.
segments.tr: वाणिज्यिक उपज प्रसंस्करण में उपयोग किए जाने वाले क्लोरीनेटेड धोने के पानी से यह महत्वपूर्ण रूप से कम नहीं होता है, और घर पर धोने से यह विश्वसनीय रूप से समाप्त नहीं होता है।

segments.src: There is no cooking step in a salad.
segments.tr: सलाद में पकाने का कोई चरण नहीं होता है।

segments.src: Every intervention that works for other pathogens — heat, sanitizer, time — is either absent or ineffective here.
segments.tr: अन्य रोगजनक सूक्ष्मजीवों के लिए काम करने वाला हर उपाय — गर्मी, सैनिटाइज़र, समय — यहाँ या तो अनुपस्थित है या अप्रभावी है।

segments.src: ## Where the trail goes cold
segments.tr: ## जहाँ सुराग खत्म हो जाता है

segments.src: When investigators trace a suspect head of lettuce backward, they are following a chain of records that was never designed for the question they are asking.
segments.tr: जब जांचकर्ता लेट्यूस के संदिग्ध बंडल का पीछे की ओर पता लगाते हैं, तो वे रिकॉर्ड की एक ऐसी श्रृंखला का पालन कर रहे होते हैं जिसे कभी उस प्रश्न के लिए डिज़ाइन ही नहीं किया गया था जो वे पूछ रहे हैं।

segments.src: A single bag or carton of leafy greens can represent produce from multiple fields, sometimes multiple farms, harvested on different days and commingled during cooling, washing, and packing.
segments.tr: पत्तेदार साग का एक एकल बैग या कार्टन कई खेतों, कभी-कभी कई फार्मों की उपज का प्रतिनिधित्व कर सकता है, जिसे अलग-अलग दिनों में काटा गया हो और ठंडा करने, धोने और पैकिंग के दौरान मिला दिया गया हो।

segments.src: That commingling is efficient.
segments.tr: वह मिश्रण (commingling) कुशल है।

segments.src: It is also a traceability solvent: it dissolves the link between one contaminated field and one sick person into a probability cloud spanning dozens of possible sources.
segments.tr: यह एक पता लगाने की क्षमता (traceability) को खत्म करने वाला घोल भी है: यह एक दूषित खेत और एक बीमार व्यक्ति के बीच के संबंध को दर्जनों संभावित स्रोतों में फैले संभावना के बादल में घोल देता है।

segments.src: The records themselves compound the problem.
segments.tr: रिकॉर्ड खुद समस्या को बढ़ा देते हैं।

segments.src: Significant portions of the produce supply chain still run on paper, PDFs, and per-company formats that do not talk to each other.
segments.tr: उपज आपूर्ति श्रृंखला के महत्वपूर्ण हिस्से अभी भी कागज, PDF और प्रति-कंपनी प्रारूपों पर चलते हैं जो एक दूसरे से संवाद नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: Each handoff — grower to cooler, cooler to processor, processor to distributor, distributor to retailer — is documented, but in a way that requires human beings to manually reconcile documents from a dozen firms.
segments.tr: हर हस्तांतरण — किसान से कूलर, कूलर से प्रोसेसर, प्रोसेसर से वितरक, वितरक से खुदरा विक्रेता — प्रलेखित है, लेकिन इस तरह से कि इंसानों को एक दर्जन फर्मों के दस्तावेजों को मैन्युअल रूप से मिलाना पड़ता है।

segments.src: Traceback that should take hours takes weeks.
segments.tr: जिस बैक-ट्रेसिंग में कुछ घंटे लगने चाहिए, उसमें हफ्तों लग जाते हैं।

segments.src: And weeks, in a perishable product with a two-week shelf life, means the evidence has already been eaten.
segments.tr: और दो सप्ताह की शेल्फ लाइफ वाले एक जल्द खराब होने वाले उत्पाद में हफ्तों का मतलब है कि सबूत पहले ही खाया जा चुका है।

segments.src: Imports add another layer.
segments.tr: आयात एक और परत जोड़ता है।

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिका

segments.src: imports a large and growing share of its fresh produce, and physical inspection of incoming food shipments covers only a small fraction of entries — the vast majority clear on paperwork and risk-based screening rather than examination.
segments.tr: अपनी ताज़ा उपज का एक बड़ा और बढ़ता हुआ हिस्सा आयात करता है, और आने वाली खाद्य खेपों का भौतिक निरीक्षण केवल एक छोटे से अंश को कवर करता है — अधिकांश भाग जांच के बजाय कागजी कार्रवाई और जोखिम-आधारित स्क्रीनिंग पर पास हो जाता है।

segments.src: That is not necessarily a scandal; inspecting everything is neither feasible nor how modern food safety is designed to work.
segments.tr: यह आवश्यक रूप से कोई घोटाला नहीं है; सब कुछ का निरीक्षण करना न तो संभव है और न ही आधुनिक खाद्य सुरक्षा को इस तरह काम करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

segments.src: The system is supposed to rely on preventive controls at the source, verified through supplier programs and audits.
segments.tr: सिस्टम को स्रोत पर निवारक नियंत्रणों पर भरोसा करना चाहिए, जिसे आपूर्तिकर्ता कार्यक्रमों और ऑडिट के माध्यम से सत्यापित किया जाता है।

segments.src: But that model depends on those upstream controls actually functioning, and on being able to identify quickly which supplier failed when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: लेकिन वह मॉडल उन अपस्ट्रीम नियंत्रणों के वास्तव में काम करने पर निर्भर करता है, और कुछ गलत होने पर यह तुरंत पहचानने में सक्षम होने पर निर्भर करता है कि कौन सा आपूर्तिकर्ता विफल रहा।

segments.src: This outbreak tested both assumptions at once.
segments.tr: इस प्रकोप ने दोनों धारणाओं का एक साथ परीक्षण किया।

segments.src: ## The rule that was supposed to fix this
segments.tr: ## वह नियम जो इसे ठीक करने वाला था

segments.src: Regulators have not been unaware of the gap.
segments.tr: नियामक इस अंतर से बेखबर नहीं रहे हैं।

segments.src: The FDA's Food Traceability Rule, issued under the Food Safety Modernization Act, was written precisely for this scenario.
segments.tr: खाद्य सुरक्षा आधुनिकीकरण अधिनियम (FSMA) के तहत जारी FDA का खाद्य ट्रैसेबिलिटी नियम (Food Traceability Rule), ठीक इसी परिदृश्य के लिए लिखा गया था।

segments.src: It requires firms handling designated high-risk foods — leafy greens prominently among them — to keep standardized, lot-level records at each critical tracking event and to produce them in a common electronic format on request.
segments.tr: इसके लिए निर्दिष्ट उच्च जोखिम वाले खाद्य पदार्थों (जिनमें पत्तेदार साग प्रमुख हैं) को संभालने वाली फर्मों को प्रत्येक महत्वपूर्ण ट्रैकिंग इवेंट में मानकीकृत, लॉट-स्तरीय रिकॉर्ड रखने और अनुरोध पर एक सामान्य इलेक्ट्रॉनिक प्रारूप में प्रस्तुत करने की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: In principle, that turns a multi-week paper chase into a database query.
segments.tr: सिद्धांत रूप में, यह हफ्तों की कागजी दौड़ को एक डेटाबेस क्वेरी में बदल देता है।

segments.src: In practice, the compliance deadline has been pushed back, most recently to 2028, following industry arguments about cost and readiness — concerns that are not trivial, particularly for smaller growers and for import chains where the first link sits in another country's regulatory system.
segments.tr: व्यावहारिक रूप से, अनुपालन की समय सीमा को पीछे धकेल दिया गया है, हाल ही में 2028 तक, लागत और तत्परता के बारे में उद्योग के तर्कों के बाद — ये ऐसी चिंताएं हैं जो मामूली नहीं हैं, विशेष रूप से छोटे उत्पादकों के लिए और आयात श्रृंखलाओं के लिए जहां पहला लिंक किसी अन्य देश की नियामक प्रणाली में बैठता है।

segments.src: The delay was defensible on its own terms.
segments.tr: देरी अपने आप में तर्कसंगत थी।

segments.src: The consequence is also plain: the outbreak now on the books happened inside the window before the fix took effect.
segments.tr: इसका परिणाम भी स्पष्ट है: रिकॉर्ड में दर्ज प्रकोप सुधार के प्रभावी होने से पहले की अवधि में हुआ।

segments.src: That is the honest tension in this story.
segments.tr: इस कहानी में यही ईमानदार तनाव है।

segments.src: There is no villain in it.
segments.tr: इसमें कोई विलेन नहीं है।

segments.src: There is a rule that would likely have shortened this traceback, an industry that raised real implementation objections, a regulator that granted more time, and a parasite that did not wait.
segments.tr: एक ऐसा नियम है जो संभवतः इस ट्रेसबैक को छोटा कर देता, एक ऐसा उद्योग जिसने वास्तविक कार्यान्वयन आपत्तियां उठाईं, एक नियामक जिसने अधिक समय दिया, और एक परजीवी जिसने इंतजार नहीं किया।

segments.src: ## What it means at the grocery store
segments.tr: ## ग्रॉसरी स्टोर पर इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: The practical guidance here is narrower than the scale of the outbreak might suggest, and it is worth being precise rather than alarming.
segments.tr: यहाँ व्यावहारिक मार्गदर्शन प्रकोप के पैमाने के सुझाव से अधिक सीमित है, और घबराने के बजाय सटीक होना फायदेमंद है।

segments.src: - **Recalls are specific.** They apply to identified lots, brands, and date ranges — not to lettuce as a category. Checking the FDA recall list against what is actually in your refrigerator is more useful than avoiding salad.
segments.tr: - **रिकॉल विशिष्ट होते हैं।** वे पहचाने गए लॉट, ब्रांड और तारीख सीमाओं पर लागू होते हैं — न कि एक श्रेणी के रूप में लेट्यूस पर। आपके रेफ्रिजरेटर में वास्तव में क्या है, इसके खिलाफ FDA रिकॉल सूची की जांच करना केवल सलाद से बचने की तुलना में अधिक उपयोगी है।

segments.src: - **Washing is not a fix for this pathogen.** Rinsing produce remains good practice for other reasons, but it should not be treated as a safeguard against *Cyclospora* specifically.
segments.tr: - **धोना इस रोगजनक के लिए कोई समाधान नहीं है।** अन्य कारणों से उपज को धोना अच्छा अभ्यास बना हुआ है, लेकिन इसे विशेष रूप से *Cyclospora* के खिलाफ सुरक्षा उपाय के रूप में नहीं माना जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Symptoms warrant a conversation with a clinician, not self-diagnosis.** Cyclosporiasis typically presents as prolonged, watery diarrhea, often relapsing, sometimes lasting weeks without treatment. It is treatable, but it requires a targeted test that a lab will generally not run unless a physician asks for it — which is why mentioning recent produce consumption or a recall matters.
segments.tr: - **लक्षण एक चिकित्सक के साथ बातचीत की मांग करते हैं, न कि स्वयं के निदान की।** साइक्लोस्पोरियासिस आमतौर पर लंबे समय तक, पानी जैसे दस्त के रूप में प्रस्तुत होता है, जो अक्सर बार-बार होता है, कभी-कभी इलाज के बिना हफ्तों तक रहता है। यह इलाज योग्य है, लेकिन इसके लिए एक लक्षित परीक्षण की आवश्यकता होती है जो एक प्रयोगशाला तब तक नहीं चलाएगी जब तक कि कोई चिकित्सक इसके लिए न कहे — यही कारण है कि हाल ही में उपज की खपत या रिकॉल का उल्लेख करना महत्वपूर्ण है।

segments.src: - **Reporting is not a formality.** Case counts and traceback both depend on people showing up and getting tested. In an outbreak driven by a pathogen this easy to miss, the confirmed number is a floor, not a measurement.
segments.tr: - **रिपोर्टिंग केवल एक औपचारिकता नहीं है।** केस की संख्या और ट्रेसबैक दोनों ही लोगों के अस्पताल पहुंचने और जांच कराने पर निर्भर करते हैं। इस तरह के चूक जाने में आसान रोगजनक द्वारा संचालित प्रकोप में, पुष्ट संख्या एक आधार रेखा (floor) है, न कि कोई अंतिम माप।

segments.src: ## The system question
segments.tr: ## प्रणालीगत प्रश्न

segments.src: Eighteen thousand cases is a large number, but it is not really the finding.
segments.tr: अठारह हजार मामले एक बड़ी संख्या है, लेकिन यह वास्तव में खोज नहीं है।

segments.src: Outbreaks of this size have happened before and will again.
segments.tr: इस आकार के प्रकोप पहले भी हुए हैं और फिर होंगे।

segments.src: The finding is that a country can move millions of pounds of raw, ready-to-eat produce through a continental supply chain every week and still need weeks to answer a basic question: *which field did this come from?* Every other part of the modern food system — pricing, logistics, inventory, demand forecasting — runs on granular real-time data.
segments.tr: खोज यह है कि एक देश हर हफ्ते एक महाद्वीपीय आपूर्ति श्रृंखला के माध्यम से लाखों पाउंड कच्ची, खाने के लिए तैयार उपज को ले जा सकता है और फिर भी एक बुनियादी सवाल का जवाब देने के लिए हफ्तों की आवश्यकता होती है: *यह किस खेत से आया था?* आधुनिक खाद्य प्रणाली का हर दूसरा हिस्सा — मूल्य निर्धारण, रसद, सूची, मांग का पूर्वानुमान — विस्तृत वास्तविक समय के डेटा पर चलता है।

segments.src: Traceability, the one function that matters most when something goes wrong, has been the last to get it.
segments.tr: ट्रैसेबिलिटी (पता लगाने की क्षमता), वह एक कार्य जो कुछ गलत होने पर सबसे अधिक मायने रखता है, इसे प्राप्त करने वाला अंतिम रहा है।

segments.src: The recalled lettuce will clear the shelves.
segments.tr: वापस मंगाया गया लेट्यूस अलमारियों से साफ हो जाएगा।

segments.src: The blind spot it exposed will still be there in the fall, and in the next harvest, and the one after that — until lot-level traceability stops being a deadline that can be extended and starts being how the pipeline simply works.
segments.tr: इसके द्वारा उजागर किया गया ब्लाइंड स्पॉट पतझड़ में, और अगली फसल में, और उसके बाद वाली फसल में भी बना रहेगा — जब तक कि लॉट-स्तरीय ट्रैसेबिलिटी एक ऐसी समय सीमा बनना बंद न हो जाए जिसे बढ़ाया जा सकता है और इस बात की शुरुआत न हो जाए कि पाइपलाइन साधारण रूप से कैसे काम करती है।

es.title: El parásito en el tazón de ensalada: lo que el mayor brote de Cyclospora en EE. UU. revela sobre un punto ciego en los productos frescos

segments.src: *Editor's note: Outbreak counts are provisional and change as state labs report.
segments.tr: *Nota del editor: los recuentos de brotes son provisionales y cambian a medida que los laboratorios estatales informan.

segments.src: For the current case tally, recall list, and clinical guidance, consult the CDC and FDA directly.
segments.tr: Para conocer el recuento actual de casos, la lista de retiradas del mercado y la orientación clínica, consulte directamente al CDC y a la FDA.

segments.src: Nothing here is medical advice.*
segments.tr: Nada de lo aquí expuesto constituye un consejo médico.*

segments.src: Most foodborne outbreaks in the United States end the same way: a recall notice, a few days of headlines, and a quiet return to normal.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los brotes transmitidos por alimentos en los Estados Unidos terminan de la misma manera: un aviso de retirada, unos días de titulares y un regreso silencioso a la normalidad.

segments.src: The cyclosporiasis outbreak that began building in May has not followed that script.
segments.tr: El brote de ciclosporiasis que comenzó a intensificarse en mayo no ha seguido ese guion.

segments.src: Federal and state health agencies now count roughly 18,000 confirmed or probable cases across 45 states — the largest cyclosporiasis outbreak on record in the U.S.
segments.tr: Las agencias de salud federales y estatales contabilizan ahora aproximadamente 18,000 casos confirmados o probables en 45 estados: el mayor brote de ciclosporiasis registrado en los EE. UU.

segments.src: Investigators have pointed to a run of imported iceberg lettuce, since recalled, as a leading vehicle.
segments.tr: Los investigadores han señalado una partida de lechuga iceberg importada, ya retirada, como el principal vehículo.

segments.src: Hundreds of people have been hospitalized.
segments.tr: Cientos de personas han sido hospitalizadas.

segments.src: The number is still moving, because the way this particular parasite gets counted almost guarantees the first number is never the final one.
segments.tr: La cifra sigue cambiando, porque la forma en que se contabiliza este parásito en particular casi garantiza que el primer número nunca sea el definitivo.

segments.src: The recall is the easy part of this story.
segments.tr: La retirada del producto es la parte fácil de esta historia.

segments.src: The hard part is what the investigation revealed on its way there: for a country that eats an enormous volume of fresh, raw, ready-to-eat produce, the United States has remarkably thin visibility into where any given leaf actually came from.
segments.tr: La parte difícil es lo que la investigación reveló en su camino hacia allí: para un país que consume un enorme volumen de productos frescos, crudos y listos para comer, los Estados Unidos tienen una visibilidad notablemente escasa sobre de dónde procede realmente una hoja determinada.

segments.src: ## A parasite built to slip through
segments.tr: ## Un parásito diseñado para escurrirse

segments.src: *Cyclospora cayetanensis* is a single-celled parasite, not a bacterium, and that distinction drives nearly everything about why it is difficult to catch.
segments.tr: *Cyclospora cayetanensis* es un parásito unicelular, no una bacteria, y esa distinción explica casi todo sobre por qué es difícil de detectar.

segments.src: It spreads through the fecal-oral route — typically when produce or water is contaminated somewhere upstream of the consumer.
segments.tr: Se transmite por vía fecal-oral, normalmente cuando los productos frescos o el agua se contaminan en algún punto anterior al consumidor.

segments.src: Unlike norovirus, it does not pass directly from person to person; the parasite's oocysts need days to weeks in the environment to become infectious.
segments.tr: A diferencia del norovirus, no se transmite directamente de persona a persona; los oocitos del parásito necesitan de días a semanas en el entorno para volverse infecciosos.

segments.src: That means a sick food handler at your local deli is not a plausible source.
segments.tr: Eso significa que un manipulador de alimentos enfermo en su tienda delicatessen local no es una fuente plausible.

segments.src: The contamination almost always happened earlier, in a field, a wash line, or an irrigation source.
segments.tr: La contaminación casi siempre ocurrió antes, en un campo, una línea de lavado o una fuente de riego.

segments.src: Its incubation period is the second problem.
segments.tr: Su período de incubación es el segundo problema.

segments.src: Symptoms usually appear about a week after exposure, sometimes longer.
segments.tr: Los síntomas suelen aparecer aproximadamente una semana después de la exposición, a veces más tarde.

segments.src: By the time someone feels ill enough to see a doctor, the meal that made them sick is a fuzzy memory, the receipt is gone, and the produce itself has been eaten or thrown out.
segments.tr: Para cuando alguien se siente lo suficientemente enfermo como para ir al médico, la comida que lo enfermó es un recuerdo difuso, el recibo ha desaparecido y el producto fresco en sí se ha comido o tirado a la basura.

segments.src: Ask a patient what they ate seven to ten days ago and you get a shrug — which is exactly what epidemiologists are working with.
segments.tr: Pregúntele a un paciente qué comió hace de siete a diez días y obtendrá un encogimiento de hombros, que es exactamente con lo que trabajan los epidemiólogos.

segments.src: Then there is detection.
segments.tr: Luego está la detección.

segments.src: Standard stool testing does not reliably find *Cyclospora* unless a lab is specifically looking for it.
segments.tr: Las pruebas de heces estándar no detectan con fiabilidad *Cyclospora* a menos que un laboratorio la busque específicamente.

segments.src: For years, that required specialized staining techniques that many labs simply did not run by default.
segments.tr: Durante años, eso requirió técnicas de tinción especializadas que muchos laboratorios simplemente no ejecutaban por defecto.

segments.src: Wider adoption of multiplex molecular panels has improved the picture considerably, but it has also introduced a distortion: some of the apparent growth in case counts reflects better testing rather than more illness.
segments.tr: La adopción más amplia de paneles moleculares multiplex ha mejorado considerablemente la situación, pero también ha introducido una distorsión: parte del crecimiento aparente en el recuento de casos refleja mejores pruebas en lugar de más enfermedades.

segments.src: Untangling the two is genuinely hard, and it is one reason public health officials tend to hedge when asked whether an outbreak is "getting worse."
segments.tr: Desentrañar ambas cosas es realmente difícil, y es una razón por la cual los funcionarios de salud pública tienden a ser cautos cuando se les pregunta si un brote "empeora".

segments.src: Finally, the parasite is durable in ways that frustrate the standard playbook.
segments.tr: Por último, el parásito es resistente de formas que frustran el protocolo estándar.

segments.src: It is not meaningfully reduced by the chlorinated wash water used in commercial produce processing, and rinsing at home does not reliably remove it.
segments.tr: No se reduce significativamente con el agua de lavado clorada utilizada en el procesamiento comercial de productos frescos, y el enjuague en casa no lo elimina de forma fiable.

segments.src: There is no cooking step in a salad.
segments.tr: No hay un paso de cocción en una ensalada.

segments.src: Every intervention that works for other pathogens — heat, sanitizer, time — is either absent or ineffective here.
segments.tr: Cada intervención que funciona para otros patógenos (calor, desinfectante, tiempo) está ausente o es ineficaz aquí.

segments.src: ## Where the trail goes cold
segments.tr: ## Donde se pierde el rastro

segments.src: When investigators trace a suspect head of lettuce backward, they are following a chain of records that was never designed for the question they are asking.
segments.tr: Cuando los investigadores rastrean una lechuga sospechosa hacia atrás, siguen una cadena de registros que nunca fue diseñada para la pregunta que están haciendo.

segments.src: A single bag or carton of leafy greens can represent produce from multiple fields, sometimes multiple farms, harvested on different days and commingled during cooling, washing, and packing.
segments.tr: Bolsas o cajas individuales de hortalizas de hoja verde pueden representar productos de múltiples campos, a veces de múltiples granjas, cosechados en días diferentes y combinados durante el enfriamiento, lavado y empaquetado.

segments.src: That commingling is efficient.
segments.tr: Esa mezcla es eficiente.

segments.src: It is also a traceability solvent: it dissolves the link between one contaminated field and one sick person into a probability cloud spanning dozens of possible sources.
segments.tr: También es un disolvente de la trazabilidad: disuelve el vínculo entre un campo contaminado y una persona enferma en una nube de probabilidad que abarca docenas de fuentes posibles.

segments.src: The records themselves compound the problem.
segments.tr: Los propios registros agravan el problema.

segments.src: Significant portions of the produce supply chain still run on paper, PDFs, and per-company formats that do not talk to each other.
segments.tr: Partes significativas de la cadena de suministro de productos frescos todavía funcionan con papel, PDFs y formatos por empresa que no se comunican entre sí.

segments.src: Each handoff — grower to cooler, cooler to processor, processor to distributor, distributor to retailer — is documented, but in a way that requires human beings to manually reconcile documents from a dozen firms.
segments.tr: Cada traspaso (del cultivador al frigorífico, del frigorífico al procesador, del procesador al distribuidor, del distribuidor al minorista) está documentado, pero de una manera que requiere que seres humanos concilien manualmente documentos de una docena de empresas.

segments.src: Traceback that should take hours takes weeks.
segments.tr: Un rastreo que debería llevar horas lleva semanas.

segments.src: And weeks, in a perishable product with a two-week shelf life, means the evidence has already been eaten.
segments.tr: Y semanas, en un producto perecedero con una vida útil de dos semanas, significa que la prueba ya se ha comido.

segments.src: Imports add another layer.
segments.tr: Las importaciones añaden otra capa.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Los EE. UU.

segments.src: imports a large and growing share of its fresh produce, and physical inspection of incoming food shipments covers only a small fraction of entries — the vast majority clear on paperwork and risk-based screening rather than examination.
segments.tr: importan una parte grande y creciente de sus productos frescos, y la inspección física de los envíos de alimentos entrantes cubre solo una pequeña fracción de las entradas; la gran mayoría se aprueba mediante trámites burocráticos y evaluaciones basadas en riesgos en lugar de exámenes.

segments.src: That is not necessarily a scandal; inspecting everything is neither feasible nor how modern food safety is designed to work.
segments.tr: Eso no es necesariamente un escándalo; inspeccionar todo no es factible ni es cómo está diseñada la seguridad alimentaria moderna.

segments.src: The system is supposed to rely on preventive controls at the source, verified through supplier programs and audits.
segments.tr: Se supone que el sistema se basa en controles preventivos en la fuente, verificados a través de programas de proveedores y auditorías.

segments.src: But that model depends on those upstream controls actually functioning, and on being able to identify quickly which supplier failed when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: Pero ese modelo depende de que esos controles previos realmente funcionen y de ser capaces de identificar rápidamente qué proveedor falló cuando algo sale mal.

segments.src: This outbreak tested both assumptions at once.
segments.tr: Este brote puso a prueba ambos supuestos a la vez.

segments.src: ## The rule that was supposed to fix this
segments.tr: ## La norma que se suponía que arreglaría esto

segments.src: Regulators have not been unaware of the gap.
segments.tr: Los reguladores no han sido ajenos a esta brecha.

segments.src: The FDA's Food Traceability Rule, issued under the Food Safety Modernization Act, was written precisely for this scenario.
segments.tr: La Norma de Trazabilidad de los Alimentos de la FDA, promulgada bajo la Ley de Modernización de la Seguridad Alimentaria, se redactó precisamente para este escenario.

segments.src: It requires firms handling designated high-risk foods — leafy greens prominently among them — to keep standardized, lot-level records at each critical tracking event and to produce them in a common electronic format on request.
segments.tr: Requiere que las empresas que manejan alimentos designados de alto riesgo (las hortalizas de hoja verde entre ellos destacadamente) mantengan registros estandarizados a nivel de lote en cada evento crítico de seguimiento y los produzcan en un formato electrónico común previa solicitud.

segments.src: In principle, that turns a multi-week paper chase into a database query.
segments.tr: En principio, eso convierte un rastreo en papel de varias semanas en una consulta a una base de datos.

segments.src: In practice, the compliance deadline has been pushed back, most recently to 2028, following industry arguments about cost and readiness — concerns that are not trivial, particularly for smaller growers and for import chains where the first link sits in another country's regulatory system.
segments.tr: En la práctica, el plazo de cumplimiento se ha pospuesto, más recientemente hasta 2028, tras los argumentos de la industria sobre costos y preparación, preocupaciones que no son triviales, particularmente para los pequeños cultivadores y para las cadenas de importación donde el primer eslabón se encuentra en el sistema regulatorio de otro país.

segments.src: The delay was defensible on its own terms.
segments.tr: El retraso era defendible en sus propios términos.

segments.src: The consequence is also plain: the outbreak now on the books happened inside the window before the fix took effect.
segments.tr: La consecuencia también es clara: el brote actualmente registrado ocurrió dentro del período anterior a que la solución entrara en vigor.

segments.src: That is the honest tension in this story.
segments.tr: Esa es la tensión real en esta historia.

segments.src: There is no villain in it.
segments.tr: No hay un villano en ella.

segments.src: There is a rule that would likely have shortened this traceback, an industry that raised real implementation objections, a regulator that granted more time, and a parasite that did not wait.
segments.tr: Hay una norma que probablemente habría acortado este rastreo, una industria que planteó objeciones reales de implementación, un regulador que concedió más tiempo y un parásito que no esperó.

segments.src: ## What it means at the grocery store
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa en el supermercado

segments.src: The practical guidance here is narrower than the scale of the outbreak might suggest, and it is worth being precise rather than alarming.
segments.tr: La orientación práctica aquí es más limitada de lo que la escala del brote podría sugerir, y vale la pena ser precisos en lugar de alarmistas.

segments.src: - **Recalls are specific.** They apply to identified lots, brands, and date ranges — not to lettuce as a category. Checking the FDA recall list against what is actually in your refrigerator is more useful than avoiding salad.
segments.tr: - **Las retiradas del mercado son específicas.** Se aplican a lotes, marcas y rangos de fechas identificados, no a la lechuga como categoría. Comprobar la lista de retiradas de la FDA con lo que realmente hay en su refrigerador es más útil que evitar la ensalada.

segments.src: - **Washing is not a fix for this pathogen.** Rinsing produce remains good practice for other reasons, but it should not be treated as a safeguard against *Cyclospora* specifically.
segments.tr: - **Lavar no es una solución para este patógeno.** Enjuagar los productos frescos sigue siendo una buena práctica por otras razones, pero no debe tratarse como una salvaguarda contra *Cyclospora* en específico.

segments.src: - **Symptoms warrant a conversation with a clinician, not self-diagnosis.** Cyclosporiasis typically presents as prolonged, watery diarrhea, often relapsing, sometimes lasting weeks without treatment. It is treatable, but it requires a targeted test that a lab will generally not run unless a physician asks for it — which is why mentioning recent produce consumption or a recall matters.
segments.tr: - **Los síntomas justifican una conversación con un médico, no el autodiagnóstico.** La ciclosporiasis se presenta típicamente como una diarrea acuosa prolongada, a menudo recurrente, que a veces dura semanas sin tratamiento. Es tratable, pero requiere una prueba específica que un laboratorio generalmente no realizará a menos que un médico la solicite, razón por la cual es importante mencionar el consumo reciente de productos frescos o una retirada del mercado.

segments.src: - **Reporting is not a formality.** Case counts and traceback both depend on people showing up and getting tested. In an outbreak driven by a pathogen this easy to miss, the confirmed number is a floor, not a measurement.
segments.tr: - **Notificar no es una formalidad.** El recuento de casos y la trazabilidad dependen de que las personas acudan y se hagan la prueba. En un brote impulsado por un patógeno tan fácil de pasar por alto, la cifra confirmada es un mínimo, no una medición.

segments.src: ## The system question
segments.tr: ## La cuestión del sistema

segments.src: Eighteen thousand cases is a large number, but it is not really the finding.
segments.tr: Dieciocho mil casos es un número elevado, pero no es realmente el hallazgo.

segments.src: Outbreaks of this size have happened before and will again.
segments.tr: Brotes de este tamaño han ocurrido antes y volverán a ocurrir.

segments.src: The finding is that a country can move millions of pounds of raw, ready-to-eat produce through a continental supply chain every week and still need weeks to answer a basic question: *which field did this come from?* Every other part of the modern food system — pricing, logistics, inventory, demand forecasting — runs on granular real-time data.
segments.tr: El hallazgo es que un país puede mover millones de libras de productos frescos, crudos y listos para comer a través de una cadena de suministro continental cada semana y aún así necesitar semanas para responder a una pregunta básica: *¿de qué campo vino esto?* Todas las demás partes del sistema alimentario moderno (precios, logística, inventario, previsión de la demanda) funcionan con datos detallados en tiempo real.

segments.src: Traceability, the one function that matters most when something goes wrong, has been the last to get it.
segments.tr: La trazabilidad, la única función que más importa cuando algo sale mal, ha sido la última en obtenerlos.

segments.src: The recalled lettuce will clear the shelves.
segments.tr: La lechuga retirada se despejará de los estantes.

segments.src: The blind spot it exposed will still be there in the fall, and in the next harvest, and the one after that — until lot-level traceability stops being a deadline that can be extended and starts being how the pipeline simply works.
segments.tr: El punto ciego que expuso seguirá estando allí en otoño, y en la próxima cosecha, y en la siguiente, hasta que la trazabilidad a nivel de lote deje de ser un plazo que se puede extender y comience a ser la forma en que simplemente funciona la cadena.

ar.title: الطفيلي في وعاء السلطة: ما يكشفه أكبر تفشٍ لطفيلي الكايلوسبورا في أمريكا عن نقطة عمياء في المنتجات الطازجة

segments.src: *Editor's note: Outbreak counts are provisional and change as state labs report.
segments.tr: *ملاحظة المحرر: أعداد الإصابات في التفشي مؤقتة وتتغير مع تقديم المختبرات الحكومية لتقاريرها.

segments.src: For the current case tally, recall list, and clinical guidance, consult the CDC and FDA directly.
segments.tr: للحصول على إحصاء الحالات الحالي، وقائمة السحب، والإرشادات السريرية، استشر CDC و FDA مباشرةً.

segments.src: Nothing here is medical advice.*
segments.tr: لا شيء هنا يعد استشارة طبية.*

segments.src: Most foodborne outbreaks in the United States end the same way: a recall notice, a few days of headlines, and a quiet return to normal.
segments.tr: تنتهي معظم تفشيات الأمراض المنقولة بالغذاء في الولايات المتحدة بنفس الطريقة: إشعار سحب، وبضعة أيام من العناوين الرئيسية، وعودة هادئة إلى الوضع الطبيعي.

segments.src: The cyclosporiasis outbreak that began building in May has not followed that script.
segments.tr: لكن تفشي مرض الكايلوسبوريات الذي بدأ بالتصاعد في مايو لم يتبع ذلك السيناريو.

segments.src: Federal and state health agencies now count roughly 18,000 confirmed or probable cases across 45 states — the largest cyclosporiasis outbreak on record in the U.S.
segments.tr: تسجل وكالات الصحة الفيدرالية والحكومية الآن ما يقرب من 18,000 حالة مؤكدة أو محتملة عبر 45 ولاية — وهو أكبر تفشٍ لمرض الكايلوسبوريات مسجل في الولايات المتحدة.

segments.src: Investigators have pointed to a run of imported iceberg lettuce, since recalled, as a leading vehicle.
segments.tr: وقد أشار المحققون إلى شحنة من خس آيسبيرج المستورد، الذي تم سحبه لاحقًا، كعامل رئيسي.

segments.src: Hundreds of people have been hospitalized.
segments.tr: وتم نقل المئات من الأشخاص إلى المستشفيات.

segments.src: The number is still moving, because the way this particular parasite gets counted almost guarantees the first number is never the final one.
segments.tr: ولا يزال العدد يتغير، لأن الطريقة التي يُحسب بها هذا الطفيلي بالتحديد تضمن تقريبًا أن الرقم الأول لن يكون الرقم النهائي أبدا.

segments.src: The recall is the easy part of this story.
segments.tr: عملية السحب هي الجزء السهل من هذه القصة.

segments.src: The hard part is what the investigation revealed on its way there: for a country that eats an enormous volume of fresh, raw, ready-to-eat produce, the United States has remarkably thin visibility into where any given leaf actually came from.
segments.tr: أما الجزء الصعب فهو ما كشفه التحقيق في طريقه إلى ذلك: بالنسبة لبلد يستهلك كميات هائلة من المنتجات الطازجة والخام والجاهزة للأكل، تمتع الولايات المتحدة برؤية ضعيفة بشكل لافت حول المصدر الحقيقي لأي ورقة شجر.

segments.src: ## A parasite built to slip through
segments.tr: ## طفيلي مصمم للتسلل

segments.src: *Cyclospora cayetanensis* is a single-celled parasite, not a bacterium, and that distinction drives nearly everything about why it is difficult to catch.
segments.tr: تعتبر *Cyclospora cayetanensis* طفيليًا أحادي الخلية، وليست بكتيريا، وهذا التمييز يحدد كل شيء تقريبًا حول سبب صعوبة اكتشافها.

segments.src: It spreads through the fecal-oral route — typically when produce or water is contaminated somewhere upstream of the consumer.
segments.tr: وتنتشر عن طريق الفم والبراز — عادة عندما تتلوث المنتجات أو المياه في مكان ما قبل وصولها إلى المستهلك.

segments.src: Unlike norovirus, it does not pass directly from person to person; the parasite's oocysts need days to weeks in the environment to become infectious.
segments.tr: وعلى عكس الفيروس النوروي، لا تنتقل مباشرة من شخص لآخر؛ إذ تحتاج أكياس البيض للطفيلي من أيام إلى أسابيع في البيئة لتصبح معدية.

segments.src: That means a sick food handler at your local deli is not a plausible source.
segments.tr: وهذا يعني أن متداول الأغذية المريض في المطعمة المحلية ليس مصدرًا محتملاً.

segments.src: The contamination almost always happened earlier, in a field, a wash line, or an irrigation source.
segments.tr: التلوث يحدث دائمًا تقريبًا في وقت أسبق، في حقل، أو خط غسيل، أو مصدر ري.

segments.src: Its incubation period is the second problem.
segments.tr: وفترة حضانته هي المشكلة الثانية.

segments.src: Symptoms usually appear about a week after exposure, sometimes longer.
segments.tr: تظهر الأعراض عادة بعد حوالي أسبوع من التعرض، وأحيانًا بعد فترة أطول.

segments.src: By the time someone feels ill enough to see a doctor, the meal that made them sick is a fuzzy memory, the receipt is gone, and the produce itself has been eaten or thrown out.
segments.tr: بحلول الوقت الذي يشعر فيه الشخص بالمرض الكافي لرؤية الطبيب، تكون الوجبة التي جعلته مريضًا ذكريات ضبابية، ويكون الإيصال قد اختفى، وتكون المنتجات نفسها قد أُكلت أو أُلقيت في القمامة.

segments.src: Ask a patient what they ate seven to ten days ago and you get a shrug — which is exactly what epidemiologists are working with.
segments.tr: اسأل مريضًا عما أكله قبل سبعة إلى عشرة أيام وستحصل على هزّة كتف — وهو بالضبط ما يعمل معه علماء الأوبئة.

segments.src: Then there is detection.
segments.tr: ثم هناك الكشف.

segments.src: Standard stool testing does not reliably find *Cyclospora* unless a lab is specifically looking for it.
segments.tr: فحص البراز القياسي لا يكتشف *Cyclospora* بشكل موثوق ما لم يكن المختبر يبحث عنها بشكل خاص.

segments.src: For years, that required specialized staining techniques that many labs simply did not run by default.
segments.tr: ولسنوات، تطلب ذلك تقنيات صبغ متخصصة لم تكن العديد من المختبرات تجريها بشكل افتراضي.

segments.src: Wider adoption of multiplex molecular panels has improved the picture considerably, but it has also introduced a distortion: some of the apparent growth in case counts reflects better testing rather than more illness.
segments.tr: لقد تحسن الوضع بشكل كبير مع الاعتماد الواسع للنطاق للفحوصات الجزيئية المتعددة، ولكنه أدخل أيضًا تشويهًا: بعض النمو الظاهري في أعداد الحالات يعكس تحسن الاختبارات وليس زيادة الأمراض.

segments.src: Untangling the two is genuinely hard, and it is one reason public health officials tend to hedge when asked whether an outbreak is "getting worse."
segments.tr: إن فك الارتباط بين الأمرين صعب للغاية، وهو أحد الأسباب التي تجعل مسؤولي الصحة العامة يميلون إلى الحذر عند سؤالهم عما إذا كان التفشي "يزداد سوءًا".

segments.src: Finally, the parasite is durable in ways that frustrate the standard playbook.
segments.tr: أخيرًا، يتميز الطفيلي بالمتانة بطرق تحبط قواعد اللعبة القياسية.

segments.src: It is not meaningfully reduced by the chlorinated wash water used in commercial produce processing, and rinsing at home does not reliably remove it.
segments.tr: فهو لا ينخفض بشكل ملحوظ بواسطة مياه الغسيل المعاملة بالكلور المستخدمة في المعالجة التجارية للمنتجات، والطفح بالماء في المنزل لا يزيله بشكل موثوق.

segments.src: There is no cooking step in a salad.
segments.tr: لا توجد خطوة طهي في السلطة.

segments.src: Every intervention that works for other pathogens — heat, sanitizer, time — is either absent or ineffective here.
segments.tr: كل تدخل يعمل مع الممرضات الأخرى — الحرارة، المطهر، الوقت — إما غائب أو غير فعال هنا.

segments.src: ## Where the trail goes cold
segments.tr: ## حيث ينقطع الأثر

segments.src: When investigators trace a suspect head of lettuce backward, they are following a chain of records that was never designed for the question they are asking.
segments.tr: عندما يتتبع المحققون رأس خس مشبوه إلى الوراء، فإنهم يتبعون سلسلة من السجلات التي لم تصمم أبدًا للسؤال الذي يطرحونه.

segments.src: A single bag or carton of leafy greens can represent produce from multiple fields, sometimes multiple farms, harvested on different days and commingled during cooling, washing, and packing.
segments.tr: يمكن لكيس واحد أو كرتونة من الخضار الورقية أن تمثل منتجات من حقول متعددة، وأحيانًا مزارع متعددة، حُصدت في أيام مختلفة وتم خلطها أثناء التبريد والغسيل والتعبئة.

segments.src: That commingling is efficient.
segments.tr: هذا الخلط فعال.

segments.src: It is also a traceability solvent: it dissolves the link between one contaminated field and one sick person into a probability cloud spanning dozens of possible sources.
segments.tr: ولكنه أيضًا مذيب للتتبع: فهو يذيب الصلة بين حقل ملوث واحد وشخص مريض واحد في سحابة احتمالات تمتد عبر العشرات من المصادر المحتملة.

segments.src: The records themselves compound the problem.
segments.tr: السجلات نفسها تزيد من تعقيد المشكلة.

segments.src: Significant portions of the produce supply chain still run on paper, PDFs, and per-company formats that do not talk to each other.
segments.tr: أجزاء كبيرة من سلسلة توريد المنتجات لا تزال تعمل على الورق و PDFs والتنسيقات الخاصة بكل شركة والتي لا تتواصل مع بعضها البعض.

segments.src: Each handoff — grower to cooler, cooler to processor, processor to distributor, distributor to retailer — is documented, but in a way that requires human beings to manually reconcile documents from a dozen firms.
segments.tr: كل تسليم — من المزارع إلى وحدة التبريد، ومن التبريد إلى المعالج، ومن المعالج إلى الموزع، ومن الموزع إلى بائع التجزئة — موثق، ولكن بطريقة تتطلب من البشر التوفيق يدويًا بين المستندات من عشرات الشركات.

segments.src: Traceback that should take hours takes weeks.
segments.tr: التتبع الذي ينبغي أن يستغرق ساعات يستغرق أسابيع.

segments.src: And weeks, in a perishable product with a two-week shelf life, means the evidence has already been eaten.
segments.tr: والأسابيع، في منتج قابل للتلف بمدة صلاحية تبلغ أسبوعين، تعني أن الأدلة قد أُكلت بالفعل.

segments.src: Imports add another layer.
segments.tr: وتضيف الواردات طبقة أخرى.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: تستورد الولايات المتحدة

segments.src: imports a large and growing share of its fresh produce, and physical inspection of incoming food shipments covers only a small fraction of entries — the vast majority clear on paperwork and risk-based screening rather than examination.
segments.tr: حصة كبيرة ومتزايدة من منتجاتها الطازجة، والتفتيش الفعلي لشحنات الأغذية الواردة يغطي فقط جزءًا صغيرًا من الشحنات — والغالبية العظمى تمر بناءً على الأوراق والفرز القائم على المخاطر بدلاً من الفحص.

segments.src: That is not necessarily a scandal; inspecting everything is neither feasible nor how modern food safety is designed to work.
segments.tr: هذا ليس فضيحة بالضرورة؛ فتفتيش كل شيء ليس عمليًا ولا هو الطريقة التي صُممت بها سلامة الأغذية الحديثة.

segments.src: The system is supposed to rely on preventive controls at the source, verified through supplier programs and audits.
segments.tr: من المفترض أن يعتمد النظام على الضوابط الوقائية عند المصدر، التي يتم التحقق منها من خلال برامج الموردين والمراجعات.

segments.src: But that model depends on those upstream controls actually functioning, and on being able to identify quickly which supplier failed when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: لكن هذا النموذج يعتمد على عمل تلك الضوابط مسبقًا بشكل فعلي، وعلى القدرة على تحديد المورد الفاشل بسرعة عندما يحدث خطأ ما.

segments.src: This outbreak tested both assumptions at once.
segments.tr: اختبر هذا التفشي كلا الافتراضين في وقت واحد.

segments.src: ## The rule that was supposed to fix this
segments.tr: ## القاعدة التي كان من المفترض أن تعالج هذا

segments.src: Regulators have not been unaware of the gap.
segments.tr: لم يكن المنظمون غافلين عن هذه الفجوة.

segments.src: The FDA's Food Traceability Rule, issued under the Food Safety Modernization Act, was written precisely for this scenario.
segments.tr: قاعدة تتبع الأغذية التابعة لـ FDA، الصادرة بموجب قانون تحديث سلامة الأغذية، كُتبت خصيصًا لهذا السيناريو.

segments.src: It requires firms handling designated high-risk foods — leafy greens prominently among them — to keep standardized, lot-level records at each critical tracking event and to produce them in a common electronic format on request.
segments.tr: فهي تتطلب من الشركات التي تتعامل مع أغذية محددة عالية المخاطر — وخاصة الخضار الورقية — الاحتفاظ بسجلات موحدة على مستوى الدفعة عند كل حدث تتبع حاسم وتقديمها بتنسيق إلكتروني مشترك عند الطلب.
